# goslop text fixture — verify=False only appears inside an error message string
lang: python
file: extensions/wasi/_utils.py
---
class SSLError(Exception):
    pass


def prepare(verify):
    if verify is not True:
        raise SSLError(
            "WASI HTTPS uses the host trust policy; verify=False and custom CA bundles are unavailable."
        )
    return True
